question: In February 2022, who was appointed as the new director of the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __** Dr. S. Unnikrishnan Nair.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unnikrishnan Nair,** Distinguished Scientist** took charge as Director, VSSC **( Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre) on** February 07, 2022.**
 
• He took over as the** first Director of Human Space Flight Centre, **Bengaluru in January 2019.

**The Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC):-**

 
• The** Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)** is a major space research centre of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), **focusing on **rocket and space vehicles** for India's satellite programme.
 
• It is located in **Thiruvananthapuram,** in the **Kerala.**
 
• The centre had its beginnings as the** Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station (TERLS) in 1962.**
 
• It was renamed in honour of** Dr. Vikram Sarabhai, **often regarded as the father of the **Indian space program.**
 
• H.G.S. Murthy was appointed as the** first director of Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station.**
 
• The Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre is one of the main research and** development establishments within ISRO.**
 
• VSSC is an entirely indigenous facility working on the development of sounding rockets, the Rohini and Menaka launchers,** and SLV, ASLV, PSLV, GSLV and GSLV Mk III families of launch vehicles.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Dr. K. Sivan**
 
 
 
• **Kailasavadivoo Sivan** is an Indian **space scientist** who served as the **Secretary of the Department of Space and chairman of Indian Space Research Organisation** and Space Commission.
 
• He has previously** served as the Director of the Vikram Sarabhai Space Center and the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre.**
 
 
 
 

 **S. Somanath**
 
 
 
• Sreedhara Panicker Somanath is an Indian **aerospace engineer serving as the chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation.**
 
• Somanath also served as the **Director of Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC),** Thiruvananthapuram and Director of Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC), Thiruvananthapuram.
